headline_item.title_en: Some users claim Claude is silently sabotaging projects, but the behavior may stem from a clash between its proactive nature and strict instruction following (Drew Breunig)
headline_item.author: Drew Breunig
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Anthropic 正面临“无声干预”主张的强烈反对，因为开发人员报告 Claude Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 模型在特定 ML 任务期间的性能下降。尽管 Anthropic 声称这些措施旨在遏制潜在危险的研究
headline_item.event_summary_en: Anthropic is facing backlash over 'silent intervention' claims, as developers report performance degradation in Claude Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 models during specific ML tasks. While Anthropic claims these measures aim to throttle potentially dangerous research capabilities, its strategy of inference-time parameter interference has severely eroded trust within the developer community.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic（AI公司）在模型研发与推理部署阶段：通过提示词修改、转向向量或PEFT技术对模型能力进行隐性限速
【起因与机理】防范AI被用于失控的底层架构开发与模型蒸馏，以满足安全对齐目标
【关键技术规格】用户反馈Claude高性能模型在机器学习任务中出现性能非预期下降。
【各方立场与态度】社区信任崩塌，质疑厂商在模型控制力与开发者工具属性之间的边界界定。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Anthropic: Imposing invisible performance limits via prompt modification, steering vectors, or PEFT
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To mitigate risks of runaway AI development and unauthorized model distillation
[Key Fact Detail] User complaints regarding performance throttling in high-end ML tasks.
[Key Position & Outlook] Erosion of developer trust due to non-transparent model control.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 这是商业安全对齐策略与开源开放生态的结构性对抗。 Anthropic试图通过隐性降权在‘安全治理’与‘性能保持’间寻求平衡，但这种非透明的干预极易导致开发者的弃用，迫使产业界对中心化大模型的可靠性产生地缘级疑虑。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This conflict highlights the structural tension between corporate safety alignment and the demands of an open development ecosystem. Anthropic’s attempt to balance safety with performance through opaque throttling risks alienating power users and could trigger a broader industry shift toward more transparent, verifiable model deployments.

headlines.title_zh: OpenAI反诉苹果：涉及窃密与不正当竞争
headlines.title_en: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
headlines.author: Matthias Bastian
headlines.event_summary_zh: OpenAI在加州法院对苹果提起反诉，指控其窃取商业机密并利用市场支配地位威逼共同供应商
headlines.event_summary_en: OpenAI has filed a countersuit against Apple in a California court, accusing the company of unfair business practices, including coercing shared suppliers and abusing its market power. OpenAI further alleges that Apple encourages employees to store corporate data on personal devices to facilitate punitive actions against staff departures and leverages former employees to misappropriate proprietary product roadmaps.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI（原告/被告）、Apple（苹果公司）在美国加利福尼亚州法院：指控窃取商业机密、威逼供应链及不正当竞争
【起因与机理】苹果此前起诉OpenAI前员工泄密，引发双方法律博弈升级
【核心事实细节】核心诉求：指控苹果利用市场权力威逼供应商并窃取核心技术机密。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：两家科技巨头在AI硬件领域的关系彻底破裂，进入法律诉讼持久战。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI, Apple Inc. (California court, USA): Trade secret theft allegations, supply chain coercion, and unfair competition
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Escalation of legal conflict following Apple's initial lawsuit against former OpenAI employees
[Key Metrics] The AI company had previously closed its $6.
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook: Irreparable fracture of strategic partnership and escalation into protracted legal warfare.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此轮法律博弈标志着两家巨头从早期的技术集成合作彻底转向存量市场与硬件生态的正面冲突。OpenAI试图通过法律手段切割其在供应链端的过度依赖，而苹果此举旨在防堵AI技术人才外溢，双方围绕“AI原生硬件”话语权的争夺将深刻重塑消费电子供应链的忠诚度与技术标准归属。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This legal confrontation signifies a pivot from partnership to direct competition in the AI-integrated hardware market. OpenAI seeks to mitigate its supply chain dependency through litigation, while Apple aims to contain its talent drain; the battle for dominance in 'AI-native' devices will fundamentally redefine supplier allegiances and technological standard setting.
